notes.title: Survivor Update v1.7.1
notes.content:
Hello Survivors! This is a small patch to fix a couple reported issues, as well as add achievements for some of the new features v1.7.0 brought. Below are the changes.

Obsidian Spiked Club:
- Fixed the graphic not showing on the UI properly

Plasma Blaster:
- Reduced max clip size to 99 from 100.
- Increased max fire rate to every 769ms

Misc:
- Added numerous achievements, and minor bugfixes

notes.title: New Update v1.7.0 for Survivor – Out Now!
notes.content:
Attention Survivors! We're excited to announce the release of update v1.7.0, bringing you brand new systems and crucial bug fixes.

[h1]What’s New:[/h1]

[h2]Throwing Weapons:[/h2]
Introducing a new throwing weapons system to enhance your combat strategy.
[list]
[*] Glass Shiv: Throw a shard of glass at the enemy when your low on ammunition.
[/list]

[h2]Melee Weapons:[/h2]
Introducing a new melee weapon system, get up close and personal to take down zombies even without any sort of ammunition.
[list]
[*] Stick Spear: Fast and nimble for quick attacks.
[*] Obsidian Spiked Club: High damage, slow, and powerful.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
Various gameplay and performance improvements to ensure a smoother experience.

Update your game now and experience these exciting new features! Keep surviving! Read the manual for the updated controls.
